prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: tall portrait illustration for the sidebar and installation-complete screen of the Korean fantasy collectible RPG Windows installer, 숲켓몬. Create finished artwork ONLY, no interface, typography or logos.
Primary request: a premium, exceptionally polished game installation artwork that visually belongs with a midnight-navy and pale-lime fantasy launcher. A majestic ancient stone gateway in a moonlit citadel, opening into brilliant but carefully contained chartreuse light; a single elegant blank dark-silver fantasy collectible card floats upright inside the portal, its thin lime filigree rim glowing. The portal occupies the central and lower middle of the composition. The stepped approach and deep architectural layers below convey arriving in a game world, with subtle luminous motes, mist and brushed metal details. Clean upper fifth reserved as quiet dark navy atmospheric space for an existing logo which will be placed separately.
Style: high-end RPG environmental key art, crisp refined painterly stone and metal, cinematic depth, richly considered lighting, sophisticated rather than a cartoon or generic wallpaper.
Palette: dominant midnight navy #080c17, slate blue, silver, and restrained vivid pale lime #c8ff6b light in the portal. Excellent silhouette and readability at small installer sidebar size.
Composition: very tall narrow portrait approximately 1:2, centered portal and floating card, visible architecture and dark breathing space at top and bottom, full bleed. No people or character redesigns. No text, no letters, no words, no logos, no computer, no monitor, no UI, no watermark.
intent: Installer header and completion artwork; existing approved logo is overlaid separately without regeneration.
